ordered_diagnoses: Primary angiitis of the central nervous system

s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of unilateral weakness and vomiting with a history of transient neurological symptoms
salient_findings: Right ankle clonus and upgoing plantar response
key_facts: 36-year-old man of Indian origin
Presented at 2:30 a.m. with acute symptoms
Awoke around midnight with headache and vomiting
No visual change or speech disturbance
History of odd sensations and occasional tremors in right arm and leg
No medical history
Nonsmoker, denied alcohol or drug use
Normal vital signs
Normal cardiorespiratory examination
Incidental 4 × 6 mm hyperdense focus in left parasagittal frontal cortex on CT
Normal CT angiography and perfusion
Normal laboratory studies except for total protein of 87 g/L
Normal chest radiograph, ECG, and transthoracic echocardiography
Recent ischemic infarction in left paramedian medulla on MRI

raw.rationale: The patient presented with acute right-sided weakness and vomiting, and brain MRI showed a recent ischemic infarction in the left paramedian medulla, which explains the patient's symptoms

rejected.label: Cavernous malformation
rejected.why: Although a small frontal cavernoma was noted on CT and MRI, it does not explain the patient's acute symptoms and recent ischemic infarction

rejected.label: Cerebral vasculitis
rejected.why: There is no evidence of inflammation or vasculitis on laboratory studies or imaging

rejected.label: Reversible cerebral vasoconstriction syndrome
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings do not suggest reversible vasoconstriction

rejected.label: Moyamoya disease
rejected.why: There is no evidence of moyamoya disease on MR angiography or other imaging studies

rejected.label: Central nervous system vasculitis
rejected.why: There is no evidence of vasculitis or inflammation on laboratory studies or imaging

rejected.label: Primary angiitis of the central nervous system
rejected.why: There is no evidence of angiitis or inflammation on laboratory studies or imaging

rejected.label: Hemorrhagic stroke
rejected.why: The patient's imaging studies show an ischemic infarction, not a hemorrhagic stroke
